rulings.model: IRS says: "Don’t enter a prior-year unallowed loss in column (c) of Part IV unless you actively participated in the activity in both the year the loss arose and the current tax year." The restatement gates Part IV only on current active participation.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; i8582 p. 10: the Part IV/V split follows current-year active participation and the tool's prior-year loss inputs carry the year the loss arose; a both-year test is outside it. Project stands.
